To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) random networks are competitive with trained networks; and (2) slot machines are a new type of random networks that are more constrained than traditional random networks but still competitive with trained networks.

(i) slot machine networks with a few random values per connection achieve highly competitive performance on standard image classification benchmarks; (ii) slot machine networks can be finetuned, and the resulting models can outperform their baselines.

(1) there exist combinations of random weights for a given network architecture that achieve competitive performance compared to traditionally learned networks; (2) our method uncovers such combinations by selecting a random weight from a fixed set of values for each individual  connection; and (3) our method achieves competitive performance with significantly fewer parameters compared to traditionally trained networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
discovering winning combinations of random weights in neural networks.
